identity.title: Runtime: inject versioned Polis welcome package into admitted agent context

values.goal: Deliver the exact versioned Polis welcome package to every newly admitted agent before its first model turn and expose per-agent delivery provenance.
values.required_outcome: A first-class Runtime orientation resource is validated, admission-injected, retained per agent by version and digest, and visible through Runtime and Observatory projections.
authority_boundary: The welcome package is orientation only and grants no authority
Runtime policy, admission, Layer 8, and operator authority remain controlling
The source welcome-package document is not modified by this issue
operator_constraints: Schedule and label as v0.92.1 for ASAP execution
Do not perform tracked work on main
Keep the implementation simple and bounded
